title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-19
lineage: Master/1st generation cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe soundcard (96Mhz/24 bit)> HD
source: Master Audience Cassette; Sony TC-124 with Sony Stereo Mic

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Aug 19 1970 Fillmore West show with a stellar acoustic set (first Ripple, Truckin', Brokedown Palace) captured on an audience tape of good quality.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a joyous acoustic set—highlighted by the debut of Ripple and early renditions of Truckin' and Brokedown Palace—and a tight electric portion where Cold Rain and Snow, China Cat Sunflower → Good Lovin', and Not Fade Away → Love Light soar.  While the tape is an audience source with occasional sloppiness, reviewers consistently praise its clarity enough to enjoy the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with many standout songs and historic firsts; recording is an audience tape but generally clear, yielding a solid overall experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note the sound quality varies—some sections are crisp while others feel a bit sloppy—but overall it is listenable and captures the acoustic vibe well.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set opens the night with historic first performances, then transitions smoothly into a high‑energy electric set; reviewers highlight the seamless flow from China Cat Sunflower through Good Lovin' as a peak.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pig's piano on How Long Blues is noted as surprisingly good, adding a fun touch to the acoustic set.
